description: Source code implementing a ring buffer (pbuf) for inter-process communication in Zephyr OS, including buffer initialization, write, and read functions with cache management.

methods.name: idx_occupied
methods.description: Calculates the number of bytes occupied in the buffer based on write and read indices.

methods.name: idx_wrap
methods.description: Wraps the index around the buffer length to maintain circular buffer behavior.

methods.name: validate_cfg
methods.description: Validates the configuration structure for the ring buffer.

methods.name: pbuf_init
methods.description: Initializes the ring buffer, setting indices to zero and flushing cache.

methods.name: pbuf_write
methods.description: Writes data into the ring buffer, handling wrapping and cache management.

methods.name: pbuf_read
methods.description: Reads data from the ring buffer, handling wrapping and cache management.
